items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: You were born in Chicago on September 8, 1923, the only son of Elijah Roger Bernard and Eleanor Broomfield Ware.

ctx.x: We will be talking at length with Mr. Ware, considered by his contemporaries and followers as a primary American bass innovator.
You were born in Chicago on September 8, 1923, the only son of Elijah Roger Bernard and Eleanor Broomfield Ware. Tell us when you became aware of music.

I became aware of music, maybe my 3rd or 4th year. By that I mean I was about 4 years old. There was a sanctified church next door to where we were living. I was living with my great aunt and my mother, and her children; my great aunt's children -- and this lady next door, they didn't have no children; Reverend Turner and his wife Della. I used to go over and have cookies and milk and whatnot.
